mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM "line_route_bus_stops" AS "r" WHERE "r"."del_flag" = 0 AND "r"."line_route_id" = CAST(#{lineRouteId} AS BIGINT)

SELECT "lrbs"."line_route_bus_stop_id" AS "lineRouteBusStopId", "lr"."line_route_id" AS "lineRouteId" FROM "line_route_bus_stops" AS "lrbs" INNER JOIN "line_routes" AS "lr" ON "lr"."del_flag" = 0 AND "lr"."line_route_id" = "lrbs"."line_route_id" INNER JOIN "lines" AS "l" ON "l"."del_flag" = 0 AND "l"."available_flag" = 1 AND "l"."rosen_id" = "lr"."rosen_id" INNER JOIN "daiya_revisions" AS "d" ON "d"."del_flag" = 0 AND "d"."rosen_id" = "l"."rosen_id" INNER JOIN "agencies" AS "a" ON "a"."available_flag" = 1 AND "a"."available_flag" = 1 AND "a"."business_corp_id" = "l"."business_corp_id" WHERE "d"."daiya_revision_id" = CAST(#{daiyaRevisionId} AS BIGINT) AND "a"."business_corp_id" = CAST(#{businessCorpId} AS BIGINT) ORDER BY "lrbs"."line_route_id" , "lrbs"."stop_sequence"
